about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: The story of how an immigrant family turned the dream of helping people travel into a real business.
about.story_p1: Michels Travel was born from a real need. In 2018, Michel, a Brazilian who had moved to New Jersey with his family, noticed something that bothered a lot of people around him: buying airline tickets was way too complicated. Confusing websites, prices that changed with every click, hidden fees, and that nagging feeling of paying more than you should.
about.story_p2: Michel started helping friends and neighbors find the best prices to travel to Brazil, Portugal, and other destinations. He would spend hours comparing fares, tracking promotions, and negotiating with airlines. It wasn't long before his phone wouldn't stop ringing. People trusted him because he treated every trip as if it were his own.
about.story_p3: That's how Michels Travel was officially born, registered in the State of New Jersey, with a commitment to do what Michel always did: find the best flight, at the best price, without the hassle. Only now, with the right technology to serve many more people.
about.mission_p1: We believe that travel shouldn't be a privilege reserved for those who know how to navigate complicated websites or have endless time to search. Everyone deserves to find a fair fare, understand what they're paying for, and have someone trustworthy behind the process.
about.mission_p2: That's why we built a platform that connects you directly to the world's major airlines, shows real and transparent prices, and lets you book your flight in minutes with complete security.
about.value1_desc: We connect you to hundreds of airlines and thousands of destinations worldwide.
about.value2_desc: Payments processed securely, end-to-end encryption, and your data always protected.
about.value3_desc: We're a family business that understands your needs because we live the same reality.
about.today_p1: Today, Michels Travel is much more than a travel agency. We're a technology platform that works for you. Our tool compares flights in real time, our document scanner eliminates data entry errors, and our support team is always available to help.
about.today_p2: We still hold the same philosophy from the beginning: treat every customer like family. Because for us, every trip matters. Whether it's a flight to Brazil to see your parents, a honeymoon in Europe, or a last-minute business trip, we're here to make sure everything goes perfectly.
about.cta_desc: Find the best flight to your destination now. Fast, secure, and hassle-free.

help.subtitle: Find answers to your questions about flights, bookings, and payments.

help.faq_search_q: How do I search for flights?
help.faq_search_a: On the home page, select origin, destination, dates, and number of passengers. Click 'Search Flights' to see available options with real-time pricing.
help.faq_booking_steps_q: What are the steps to book?
help.faq_booking_steps_a: 1) Search flights and choose your preferred option. 2) Fill in passenger details. 3) Pay with a credit card. 4) Receive your confirmation with a reference code.
help.faq_multi_city_a: Yes! In the search, select 'Multi-City' and add up to 5 different legs in the same booking.
help.faq_passengers_q: How many passengers can I include per booking?
help.faq_passengers_a: You can include up to 9 passengers per booking, including adults, children, and infants.
help.faq_payment_methods_a: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) securely processed via Stripe.
help.faq_payment_secure_a: Yes, all payments are processed by Stripe, a world leader in online payments, with end-to-end encryption and PCI DSS compliance.
help.faq_currency_q: What currency are prices shown in?
help.faq_currency_a: Prices are displayed in US dollars (USD). The final amount on your card may vary depending on your bank's exchange rate.
help.faq_manage_booking_q: How do I track my booking?
help.faq_manage_booking_a: Go to 'My Trips' in the menu to see all your bookings. You can also look up a booking using the reference code (MT-XXXXXX) and email.
help.faq_cancel_a: Yes, you can request cancellation in 'My Trips'. The refund amount depends on the airline's rules and will be shown before confirmation.
help.faq_baggage_q: How do I add extra baggage?
help.faq_baggage_a: During the booking process, you can select extra baggage for each passenger. Options and prices are provided by the airline.
help.faq_reference_q: Where do I find my reference code?
help.faq_reference_a: Your reference code (format MT-XXXXXX) appears on the confirmation page and is sent via email. Use it to look up your booking.
help.faq_create_account_q: How do I create an account?
help.faq_create_account_a: Click 'Sign In' in the top right corner, choose Email or GitHub, and follow the flow to sign in or create your account.
help.faq_edit_profile_q: How do I edit my profile?
help.faq_edit_profile_a: After logging in, go to 'My Profile' in the menu to update your personal information and preferences.
help.faq_contact_a: You can reach us through the internal messaging system, chat with assistant Mia, email, or phone. We're here to help!
help.faq_response_time_q: What is the support response time?
help.faq_response_time_a: We respond to messages within 24 hours. For urgent matters, use the chat with assistant Mia, available 24/7.
help.faq_live_help_q: Can I talk to a live agent?
help.faq_live_help_a: Yes! In the chat with Mia, request live assistance and one of our specialists will join the conversation to help you in real time.
